desc: negative: Try to flush action which is referenced by filter

match.pattern: (?sm)total acts 1.*action order [0-9]*: gact action pass.*index 1 ref 2 bind 1

pre: ip link add v0p1 type veth peer name v0p0 && ip link set v0p1 up && ip link set v0p0 up
tc qdisc add dev v0p1 ingress
tc actions add action pass index 1
tc filter add dev v0p1 protocol all ingress prio 1 handle 0x1234 matchall action gact index 1
